svg.title: VC20 cost structure: standard cost of the twin and full cost
svg.text: 04 – Cost structure per unit: twin standard cost of the 3 models and a full-cost view of the VC20 (USD, example values)
Bar length to scale: 1 px = $0.5. Grey shades = cost elements, red outline = margin / profit. Config prices look OPTIMISTIC – check with a market study (chapter 27.6).
Small segments: standard = conversion (mid grey) + energy (dark). Full cost = tooling + energy 6.30 · labour 47.49 · maintenance + fixed 10.95 · depreciation 28.45 (dark greys).
VC20 conversion in the twin: 13 groups, min × rate
• Material = 97 % of the twin standard cost
and 89 % of the full manufacturing cost.
• Full cost adds labour, fixed cost,
• Margin 47 % on standard cost is NOT profit.
Real market prices may be lower: −20 %
standard vs full cost, price check
